mapper.select: SELECT INTERVIEW_NO, PROCESS_NO, USER_ID, INTERVIEW_DATE, INTERVIEW_LOCATION, INTERVIEW_TYPE, INTERVIEW_PASS_SCORE FROM INTERVIEW WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}

SELECT r.INTERVIEW_REVIEW_NO, r.INTERVIEW_NO, r.COM_ID, r.JOB_CODE, r.INTERVIEW_DATE, r.INTERVIEW_REVIEW_DATE, i.INTERVIEW_INFORMATION_NO, i.EVALUATION, i.INTERVIEW_LEVEL, i.INTERVIEW_TYPE, i.INTERVIEW_CONTENT, p.PASS_INFORMATION_NO, p.INTERVIEW_QUESTION, p.TIP, p.INTERVIEW_PASS_YN FROM INTERVIEW_REVIEW r LEFT JOIN INTERVIEW_INFORMATION i ON r.INTERVIEW_REVIEW_NO = i.INTERVIEW_REVIEW_NO LEFT JOIN PASS_INFORMATION p ON r.INTERVIEW_REVIEW_NO = p.INTERVIEW_REVIEW_NO WHERE r.INTERVIEW_REVIEW_NO = #{interviewReviewNo}

SELECT INTERVIEW_REVIEW_NO, INTERVIEW_NO, COM_ID, JOB_CODE, INTERVIEW_DATE, TO_CHAR(INTERVIEW_REVIEW_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'), USER_ID FROM INTERVIEW_REVIEW WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY INTERVIEW_REVIEW_DATE DESC

SELECT INTERVIEW_REVIEW_NO, INTERVIEW_NO, COM_ID, JOB_CODE, INTERVIEW_DATE, TO_CHAR(INTERVIEW_REVIEW_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'), USER_ID FROM INTERVIEW_REVIEW WHERE COM_ID = #{comId} ORDER BY INTERVIEW_REVIEW_DATE DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO INTERVIEW_REVIEW( INTERVIEW_REVIEW_NO, INTERVIEW_NO, COM_ID, JOB_CODE, INTERVIEW_DATE, INTERVIEW_REVIEW_DATE, USER_ID )VALUES( #{interviewReviewNo}, #{interviewNo}, #{comId}, #{jobCode}, #{interviewDate}, SYSDATE, #{userId} )
